name: InPlayerEpisodePreview
overview: TV-friendly in-player episode browsing with continuous remote navigation.
description: Independent TV edition by jampez77, inspired by and based on Namo2/InPlayerEpisodePreview. Browse episodes across seasons using your remote, with titles, descriptions, and thumbnails. Desktop and mobile retain the original player button.

versions.changelog:
## Changelog
Add TV browsing for the current film and similar Jellyfin films, with resume support. Add Live TV channel browsing with current programme details and explicit channel selection. Preserve episode navigation and the original desktop preview. Add movie and Live TV demo modes, new screenshots, and a public interactive demo linked from the README.

TV edition: Down opens episode browsing, Left/Right crosses season boundaries and wraps around the show, Up/Back closes, and OK plays or resumes. Includes season and episode titles, descriptions, thumbnails, and the original player button for non-TV layouts. Based on Namo2/InPlayerEpisodePreview.
